input_fields.name: object_current_name
input_fields.description: One object identity together with its observed current name.

input_fields.name: expected_name
input_fields.description: One expected name under the declared naming scope.

result_fields.name: name_comparison_result
result_fields.description: Target identity, observed name, expected name, and comparison.

procedure: Resolve one target object and read its current name.
Compare the exact name under the declared case/scope rules.
Do not rename, search for a replacement object, or infer membership from the name.
rejection_rules: Reject an ordinal-only/ambiguous object identity or an undefined case/scope rule.
Reject a name match from a different object.
Do not convert mismatch into an automatic rename.
